result.summary: Found a few visible problems, mainly a missing restaurant image and content being obscured/clipped by fixed or horizontally scrolling UI elements.

issues.description: The first card under “Popular right now” shows a gray image placeholder with a broken/missing image icon instead of the restaurant image.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image URL loads correctly and provide a proper fallback image if the restaurant image is unavailable.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card image is partially covered by the fixed bottom navigation bar, making the content look cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content area so cards are not hidden behind the bottom navigation.

issues.description: Horizontal carousel items are visibly clipped at the right edge, including the category chips and the “Fastest near you” restaurant cards.
issues.suggestion: If clipping is intentional, add clearer carousel affordance or spacing; otherwise adjust item widths/margins so visible items fit cleanly within the viewport.
